stories.title: Game 1 Recap — Cubs Hammer Dodgers, Boyd Moves to 7-1
stories.angle: Cubs won emphatically Monday night — Boyd earns the win (now 7-1). Seiya Suzuki, Carson Kelly, and Kevin Alcántara each hit 2-run HRs. Michael Busch drove in 3 runs against his former team. Dodgers drop their 4th straight. has_score=False insight: do NOT lead with final score.

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
Matthew Boyd, 7-1. That happened in August.

Suzuki, Kelly, and Alcántara all went deep. Busch drove in three against his former team. The Dodgers are now in a four-game slide.

Post-deadline Cubs mean business. 🔥

stories.title: Full Deadline Haul — Jed Hoyer Makes Four Deals in 24 Hours
stories.angle: Yesterday's pipeline only covered Gausman. Fresh angle: the full picture — Clay Holmes (2.39 ERA before May fractured fibula) + Ryan Zeferjahn (reliever, from Angels) + Braxton Garrett (LHP, from Marlins) + Tyrone Taylor (OF, from Mets). Four separate deals to add pitching depth and bench depth. Hoyer quote: "In some ways we were as focused as I can remember in a deadline."

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
Gausman. Holmes. Garrett. Zeferjahn. Taylor.

Jed Hoyer made four deadline deals in 24 hours. Holmes posted a 2.39 ERA before May's fractured fibula. That's a No. 3 starter on the mend.

The message is clear: Cubs are here to win in October.

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #MLB

stories.title: Wild Card Standings — Cubs Extend Lead at 64-49
stories.angle: Cubs 64-49, No. 1 NL Wild Card. D-backs and Phillies both around 4 games back. Brewers have the Central. Cardinals irrelevant at 54-57. Gap is growing — solid chance to push it further tonight.

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Cubs: 64-49. No. 1 NL Wild Card.
D-backs and Phillies: both around 4 games back.
Cardinals: irrelevant.

That gap doesn't close itself — and last night made it bigger.

#Cubs #NorthSiders #MLB

stories.title: PCA MVP Surge — Now at +100 vs Ohtani's -130
stories.angle: PCA's odds surged from +3000 six weeks ago to +100. Ohtani fell from -1500 to -130 due to knee inflammation and biceps issues. PCA's last 235 PA: .349 BA, 18 HR, .728 SLG. He's playing against Ohtani's team TONIGHT — direct MVP showdown narrative. Bold take: PCA is the best player in the NL.

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Six weeks ago Ohtani was -1500 to win NL MVP. Tonight he's -130 — and PCA is +100.

Pete Crow-Armstrong: .349 BA over his last 235 PA, 18 HRs in that stretch. 24 HR, 26 SB on the season.

He's the best player in the National League. 🏆

stories.title: Roster Moves — Merryweather Back on IL (2nd Stint)
stories.angle: Julian Merryweather returns to IL with right knee tendonitis — his second stint this season. Keegan Thompson and Daniel Palencia recalled. Jack Neely optioned. Deadline haul (Zeferjahn, Garrett) gives Hoyer the depth to absorb the setback.

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
Julian Merryweather is back on the IL — right knee tendonitis, second stint this season.

Thompson and Palencia recalled. Zeferjahn already in the fold from the deadline.

Hoyer built a bullpen with depth for exactly this reason.

stories.title: Skubal Dodgers Debut Tonight at Wrigley — Assad vs Skubal
stories.angle: Tarik Skubal (two-time Cy Young winner) makes his FIRST Dodgers start TONIGHT at Wrigley Field. Cubs are literally the first team in MLB to face the new Dodger ace. Assad (6-1, 3.86 ERA) is the counter. Dodgers on a 4-game skid, Cubs already won game 1 in style. Maximum hype slot: don't lead with Skubal's stats — lead with the matchup itself (opponent + stakes). Kicker: the narrative.

x_posts.text:
Two-time Cy Young winner. Dodgers ace. Wrigley Field. Tonight.

Tarik Skubal makes his Dodgers debut in the loudest possible venue — and Javier Assad has a 6-1 record and something to say about it.

7:05 PM CT. Let's go. 🔥
